meta.title: 一个视频讲清2021年河南暴雨成因
meta.title_en: One Video: The Causes of the 2021 Henan Rainstorm

scenes.title_cn: 开场：为什么讲河南暴雨
scenes.title_en: Opening: Why Talk About the Henan Rainstorm
scenes.context: 2026年7月上旬我国接连遭遇台风，从华南一路到东北出现大范围暴雨。但最近几年最严重的暴雨灾害是2021年的河南暴雨。李永乐老师今天想从中学地理的角度，谈谈河南暴雨的成因。语域：科普教学，课堂引入。
sentences: 从华南沿海一路延伸至华东、江淮、华北，多地都出现大范围暴雨。
Heavy rain swept from the South China coast through East China, the Yangtze-Huaihe region, and North China.
heavy rain（暴雨）；sweep through（一路延伸）
最近几年最严重的暴雨灾害，是2021年的河南暴雨。
The worst rainstorm disaster in recent years was the 2021 Henan floods.
the worst disaster（最严重的灾害）；the 2021 Henan floods（河南暴雨）
今天我想从中学地理的角度，给大家简单地谈一谈。
Today I'd like to explain it simply from a middle-school geography angle.
from a geography angle（从地理角度）
paraphrase: 暴雨 → heavy rain / torrential rain / rainstorm
heavy rain · torrential rain
从…角度 → from a … angle / through the lens of
from an angle · through the lens of
scenes.speak: Heavy rain swept from the South China coast through East China, the Yangtze-Huaihe region, and North China. The worst rainstorm disaster in recent years was the 2021 Henan floods. Today I'd like to explain it simply from a middle-school geography angle.

scenes.title_en: Atmospheric Circulation: Driven by Temperature Differences
scenes.context: 从本质上讲，降雨的原因是大气的运动。某个地区因日照出现冷热不均：热的地方空气膨胀上升形成低压区，冷的地方空气下沉形成高压区；高压推着空气流向低压，形成大气环流。语域：科普教学，概念讲解。
sentences: 从本质上来讲，降雨的原因是大气的运动。
At its core, rainfall is caused by the movement of the atmosphere.
at its core（本质上）；the movement of the atmosphere（大气运动）
在热的地区，因为空气膨胀，所以就会上升。
In a hot region, the air expands and therefore rises.
expand（膨胀）；rise（上升）
高压区的气压比较大，就会把空气推着向低压区流动。
High-pressure zones push air toward low-pressure zones.
high-pressure zones（高压区）；low-pressure zones（低压区）
paraphrase: 本质上 → at its core / fundamentally
at its core · fundamentally
把空气推向 → push air toward / drive air into
push air toward · drive air into
scenes.speak: At its core, rainfall is caused by the movement of the atmosphere. In a hot region, the air expands and therefore rises. High-pressure zones push air toward low-pressure zones.

scenes.title_cn: 温度差异的来源：太阳与海陆
scenes.title_en: Sources of Temperature Differences: The Sun and Land–Sea
scenes.context: 温度差异主要来自太阳：太阳直射的地方热，两极冷。还有海陆影响：水的比热容大，白天陆地升温快，晚上降温快；以及地形、城市热岛效应等。李老师重点谈太阳和海陆差异。语域：科普教学，因素列举。
sentences: 太阳的直射点不一样，直射的地方就比较热。
The sun's direct point varies, so places directly under it are hotter.
the direct point of the sun（太阳直射点）
因为水的比热容比较大，白天的时候陆地升温就快，晚上降温也快。
Water has a high specific-heat capacity, so land heats up quickly by day and cools quickly at night.
specific-heat capacity（比热容）；heat up（升温）
城市因为有热岛效应，所以也会出现温度的差异。
Cities create heat-island effects, which also cause temperature differences.
heat-island effect（热岛效应）
paraphrase: 比热容 → specific-heat capacity / how slowly a substance warms
specific heat · heat capacity
热岛效应 → heat-island effect / urban heat
heat island · urban heat
scenes.speak: The sun's direct point varies, so places directly under it are hotter. Water has a high specific-heat capacity, so land heats up quickly by day and cools quickly at night. Cities create heat-island effects, which also cause temperature differences.

scenes.title_cn: 三圈环流：从热带到极地
scenes.title_en: Three-Cell Circulation: From Tropics to Poles
scenes.context: 太阳直射造就热带低压区，两极是极地高压区。实际气流还受地转偏向力影响：上升气流往北吹，到北纬30度左右转成水平，形成副热带高压区。加上副极地低压，共形成三圈环流。语域：科普教学，模型推演。
sentences: 最热的地方在赤道附近，我们管它叫热带低压区。
The hottest region is near the equator — we call it the tropical low-pressure belt.
the equator（赤道）；low-pressure belt（低压区）
地转偏向力在北半球，会使得气流向右侧移动。
The Coriolis effect deflects moving air to the right in the Northern Hemisphere.
the Coriolis effect（地转偏向力）；deflect（偏转）
气流到了副热带，不能再往北走，就在这里下沉堆积。
Once the air reaches the subtropics, it can't go north anymore, so it sinks and piles up here.
the subtropics（副热带）；sink（下沉）
paraphrase: 地转偏向力 → the Coriolis effect / the Coriolis force
Coriolis effect · Coriolis force
下沉堆积 → sink and pile up / descend and accumulate
sink and pile up · descend and accumulate
scenes.speak: The hottest region is near the equator — we call it the tropical low-pressure belt. The Coriolis effect deflects moving air to the right in the Northern Hemisphere. Once the air reaches the subtropics, it can't go north anymore, so it sinks and piles up here.

scenes.title_cn: 近地面的风：信风与西风带
scenes.title_en: Surface Winds: Trade Winds and Westerlies
scenes.context: 在三圈环流模式下，近地面的风方向基本确定：副热带高压吹向赤道的风偏西形成东北信风；吹向副极地的风偏东，形成西风带；极地高压吹出的风偏西，形成极地东风带。还讲了个二战气球炸弹的小故事说明西风带。语域：科普教学，举例生动。
sentences: 这个风从东北方吹来，所以我们管它叫东北信风。
This wind blows from the northeast, so we call it the northeast trade wind.
trade wind（信风）
这个区域盛行西风，所以我们管它叫西风带。
Westerlies prevail in this zone, so we call it the westerly belt.
prevail（盛行）；the westerly belt（西风带）
日本人做了很多炸弹气球，靠着西风带一路飘到了美国本土。
The Japanese sent bomb balloons that drifted across the Pacific on the westerlies to the U.S. mainland.
bomb balloons（炸弹气球）；drift（飘）
paraphrase: 盛行 → prevail / dominate
prevail · dominate
一路飘到 → drift across / float over
drift across · float over
scenes.speak: This wind blows from the northeast, so we call it the northeast trade wind. Westerlies prevail in this zone, so we call it the westerly belt. The Japanese sent bomb balloons that drifted across the Pacific on the westerlies to the U.S. mainland.

scenes.title_en: Sea and Land Breezes: Sea by Day, Land by Night
scenes.context: 实际模型比简化模型复杂得多，海陆影响很大。白天陆地升温快形成低压，海洋相对冷形成高压，风从海洋吹向陆地形成海风；晚上陆地降温快形成高压，风从陆地吹向海洋形成陆风，这就是海陆风现象。语域：科普教学，对比讲解。
sentences: 这个模型只是最简化的一个模型，实际的模型比这个要复杂得多。
This is only the simplest model — the real one is far more complex.
far more complex（复杂得多）
白天的时候陆地升温特别快，形成低压区。
By day the land heats up quickly, forming a low-pressure area.
form a low-pressure area（形成低压区）
白天和晚上风向不一样的现象，我们就称之为海陆风现象。
This shift in wind direction between day and night is called the sea-and-land breeze.
wind direction（风向）；sea-and-land breeze（海陆风）
paraphrase: 复杂得多 → far more complex / much more complicated
far more complex · more complicated
海陆风 → sea-and-land breeze / the onshore-offshore wind
sea-and-land breeze · onshore breeze
scenes.speak: This is only the simplest model — the real one is far more complex. By day the land heats up quickly, forming a low-pressure area. This shift in wind direction between day and night is called the sea-and-land breeze.

scenes.title_cn: 三大成因之一：热力环流与台风
scenes.title_en: Cause One: Thermal Circulation and Typhoons
scenes.context: 暴雨成因有三种。第一，印度大陆夏天温度高形成低压，切断副热带高压带，副高中心集中在太平洋上，东南季风带着大量水汽吹向中国大陆。第二，台风烟花在东南沿海盘旋，加上南方的台风查帕卡，两个气旋夹击让气流只能涌向大陆。语域：科普教学，成因拆解。
sentences: 因为南亚大陆切断了副热带高压带，所以副高的中心集中在太平洋上。
The South Asian landmass splits the subtropical high, so its center sits over the Pacific.
the subtropical high（副热带高压）；split（切断）
形成了东南方向的季风，带有大量的水汽，就容易形成降雨。
The southeast monsoon carries huge amounts of moisture, making rain likely.
the southeast monsoon（东南季风）；moisture（水汽）
台风烟花在东南沿海，加上南方的台风查帕卡，一起作用不让气流往下走。
Typhoon In-fa sat off the coast, and with Typhoon Cempaka in the south, the pair blocked the airflow from going south.
block the airflow（挡住气流）
paraphrase: 切断 → split / sever / break the belt
split · sever
挡住气流 → block the airflow / trap the air
block the airflow · trap the air
scenes.speak: The South Asian landmass splits the subtropical high, so its center sits over the Pacific. The southeast monsoon carries huge amounts of moisture, making rain likely. Typhoon In-fa sat off the coast, and with Typhoon Cempaka in the south, the pair blocked the airflow from going south.

scenes.title_cn: 三大成因之二：太行山地形雨
scenes.title_en: Cause Two: Orographic Rain at the Taihang Mountains
scenes.context: 第三，为什么郑州下得特别大？因为郑州正好在太行山脚下。水汽从太平洋吹过来，遇到太行山被迫抬升、遇冷凝结，形成地形雨。所以河南暴雨是热力环流、台风、地形多个因素共同作用的结果。语域：科普教学，收束升华。
sentences: 中国一共有三个阶梯，西高东低，太行山是第二和第三阶梯的分界线。
China has three terrain steps, rising from east to west, with the Taihang Mountains as the boundary between the second and third steps.
terrain steps（阶梯）；the boundary（分界线）
水汽到了太行山之后，被迫抬升，遇冷凝结，形成降雨。
Moisture forced up the Taihang Mountains cools, condenses, and turns into rain.
forced up（被迫抬升）；condense（凝结）
这一次的降雨，是多个因素共同作用造成的。
This downpour was caused by multiple factors working together.
multiple factors（多个因素）；work together（共同作用）
paraphrase: 被迫抬升 → forced up / lifted by the terrain
forced up · lifted by terrain
共同作用 → work together / combine to cause
work together · combine
scenes.speak: China has three terrain steps, rising from east to west, with the Taihang Mountains as the boundary between the second and third steps. Moisture forced up the Taihang Mountains cools, condenses, and turns into rain. This downpour was caused by multiple factors working together.

practice: At its core, rainfall is caused by the movement of the atmosphere.
High-pressure zones push air toward low-pressure zones.
The Coriolis effect deflects moving air to the right in the Northern Hemisphere.
This downpour was caused by multiple factors working together.
pitfalls: Water heats fast in the day.
Land heats up quickly by day and cools down quickly at night.
升温用 heat up；说「白天陆地升温快」主语是 land，不要丢掉 day/night 对比。
The typhoon blocks the air goes south.
The pair of typhoons blocked the airflow from going south.
block … from doing 才是「挡住…使其不能」的固定搭配。
The moisture was forced up and condensed.
forced to rise / forced up + condense（凝结）才是完整表达。
The rain is caused for many reasons.
This downpour was caused by multiple factors working together.
原因表达用 caused by；downpour/rainstorm 比 rain 更符合「暴雨」。
shifts: 用 downpour（暴雨）、torrential rain（瓢泼大雨）、rainstorm（暴雨灾害）区分强度
用 air rises and sinks（升降）、circulation（环流）、monsoon（季风）、trade wind（信风）
用 multiple factors working together（多因素叠加）、block the airflow（拦截水汽）、forced up（地形抬升）
footer_notes: ASR 专有名词已校正：美沙课→美莎克、8V→台风、负热带高压→副热带高压、池道→赤道、尾线→纬线、地转偏向立→地转偏向力、海峰→海风、陆峰→陆风、寄风→季风、烟花→烟花、查帕卡→查帕卡、清港高原→青藏高原、太行山→太行山、李永藤→李永乐等。
